assumptions.track: EXPLORATORY RETROSPECTIVE v1 — not validated historical performance
assumptions.strictProgram: Unchanged and independently gated; no strict pass is conferred by these results

evaluation.reason: Existing dated public baseline roster/GICS/CIK plus common recovered prices; chosen before any returns

assumptions.arms: Exact 12 labels and research proposals from tools/c1-research/research-spec-v1.json; all current October semantics retrospectively activated, no historical deployment claim
assumptions.execution: Source normalized model projection, source cash cap on full plan, subsequent source screen, hypothetical whole-share fills and source ledger continuation. No backfill of rejected screen orders. Fresh hypothetical funding limit equals prior-close cash floored to cents; no same-opening proposed sale funding. Nonconditional prices already include side cost. Standing stop: daily low <= known stop; min(open,stop) minus sell cost once, clipped to actual held shares. Open09:30Eastern; conditional fill19:00UTC is bookkeeping only, not observed intraday timestamp. No claimed live quotes.
assumptions.sizing: Frozen rank schedules: p(r)=low+(high-low)*(9-r)/8 using causal original snapshot rank. Low/high A=.05/.20 B=.075/.25 C=.10/.30 of each separate sleeve decision-close equity, total C1 equity excludes MSTR. Target fixed until next-open execution, whole-share floor, existing sector/issuer/cash/minimumtrade caps and one-share lowerbound allowance. No inter-sleeve transfers. Retention rank6 independent of capacity. Unscreened shadow ranks must be resolved explicitly, never silently extrapolated.
assumptions: Fixed conditional December2024 baseline roster, no subsequent additions/removals; ex-post action/price-gap exclusions explicitly induce selection bias
Carry dated December2024 sector/issuer labels forward; no historical classification-continuity claim
Unknown events treated clear as explicit omission; no invented publication times or original vintage

Vendor full split-adjusted price view rebased to baseline non-split close; target-window split/distribution/BDX/LEN/WDC exclusions. Source adjusted flag denotes simulation price basis only, not certification
No dividend, interest or tax cashflows; reported portfolio return is price P&L after modeled costs, not verified historical total investment return
Provider full-view volume may have unit revisions; no independent historical volume confirmation
sensitivities: All12 arms at12bps with volume multiplied by0.8, including warmup, tests liquidity-threshold sensitivity

All12 arms at12bps on same panel with only supported current provider sector proxies substituted; missing current labels retain dated baseline labels explicitly. This is taxonomy/date sensitivity, not historical sector evidence

All12 arms at12bps with event-unverified entries entirely blocked: conservative omission bound, unchanged exits, expected cash-only from cash seed; no performance superiority inference from this bound
causalGates: All used raw response hashes match receipts

decisionsBeforeResults.KEEP: Keep research candidate only if positive deltaCAGR12 and nonnegative25, drawdown not more than2percentagepoints worse, turnover<=1.25control, HolmP<.05 and sensitivity direction stable. No production approval.
decisionsBeforeResults.REJECT: Reject pilot case if negative delta at all3costs, paired95percent deltaCAGR upper bound<0 and direction stable across informative sensitivities. No universal rejection from one short regime.
decisionsBeforeResults.INVESTIGATE: All other outcomes, including inadequate sample or incomplete sensitivity execution. Current production stays unchanged.
